rationale: The description presents conventional HCI data protection through multiple copies, hardware-failure recovery, and integrated storage, networking, and compute management.
evidence_spans: Nutanix AOS protects application data for workloads running on an HCI cluster by storing multiple copies of the data. AOS stores multiple copies on different nodes within the cluster so data can be automatically recovered in the event of hardware failure.
With one-click simplicity, AOS streamlines IT operations and relieves budget pressures by integrating storage, networking, and compute services into a single solution managed by IT generalists.
